summary: Tested the 'Llámame más tarde' auto-callback feature end to end. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed. Covered target()/fit_window() rules, vapi.tools() adding schedule_callback for outbound only, handle_tool_calls schedule_callback (creates exactly 1 'programada' lead with the right UTC run_at, callback_of and callback_count=1; a second call reschedules instead of duplicating; callback_count=2 gets ok:false), finalize_call (status becomes 'rellamada'; no_llamar cancels the pending callback), GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/callbacks (auth required, isolation between tenants, 422 for past/weekend/<9:00/>=21:00/bad format, 404 for unknown or invalid ids, PATCH updates run_at and the original lead's callback_at, DELETE sets 'cancelada', clears the original lead's callback_id and drops it from the list). Frontend: amber callback events with a phone icon in the week view, cal-count 'N citas · M rellamadas', legend 'Rellamada automática', callback dialog (phone, info 'rellamada 1 de 2 · Marta', save button disabled until the value changes, weekend rejected with a toast, valid change moves the event, cancel removes it), 'Ver la llamada anterior' opens LeadDetail with the lead-callback box, drag-move of callbacks works (dropping on Saturday is rejected and reverted), normal appointments still open the old detail dialog, month view shows callbacks, and the 'Rellamada programada'/'Programada'/'Cancelada' badges are readable in the light theme.

minor.issue: If the callback is cancelled (or later carried out), the original lead keeps status 'rellamada', so the leads list still shows the badge 'Rellamada programada' even though nothing is scheduled. The DELETE handler clears callback_id/callback_at but does not change status. Suggest changing the label to something neutral like 'Pidió rellamada', or resetting/deriving the status.

When lead.callback_id points to a callback that is no longer 'programada' (e.g. cancelled by cancel_for on no_llamar, which does NOT clear callback_id, or already dialled), update_one matches nothing but the tool still returns ok:true. The agent then confirms a callback that does not exist. Check matched_count, or fall back to creating a new callback.
Only weekday and hour are checked; Spanish public holidays are ignored (nice-to-have).

issues: callback-edit-start is the native <input type='datetime-local'>. It renders in the browser's locale (en-US '10/21/2026, 12:00 PM', 12h AM/PM) inside a Spanish UI. Consider the shadcn date picker plus a 24h time select.
'Cancelar rellamada' acts immediately with no confirmation.
The 'capitalize' class title-cases every word: 'Jueves, 22 De Octubre · 16:30'. Only the first letter should be uppercase (use cap() as CallbackDetail does).
Callbacks at times outside the appointment hours (e.g. 17:30) sit on the hatched 'Fuera de horario' area, which may suggest they are invalid. Minor.
